The End of the Wild West

February 27, 2026

It’s time to come clean; I’ve been cowboy coding for years.

I was hired as a new grad at a non-tech company in 2019 and have been a solo developer there since 2021. While our codebase wasn’t an abjact disaster (we at least used version control), I wanted to write about my experience with trying to make positive changes and detail my perspective along the way.

Bookmark this site, because we’re going to start with a fun one - Using Git Beyond Commit & Push
